channel.title: Nofakey.ai Blog
channel.description: Guides on spotting fake news, scams, and misinformation before you share them.

item.title: How to Check If a Bank Message Is Fake
item.description: Got a text saying your bank account will be blocked unless you 'update KYC' right now? Here's how to tell if a bank message is real or a scam.

item.title: How to Check If a Delivery Message Is a Scam
item.description: A text says your parcel is stuck and needs a small fee to be released? Here's how to tell a real delivery notice from a scam before you pay anything.

item.title: How to Check If a Job Offer Message Is a Scam
item.description: Got an unexpected job offer on WhatsApp or email? Here's how to tell a real opportunity from a scam before you hand over any money or details.

item.title: How to Check If a Lottery or Prize Message Is Fake
item.description: A message says you've won a lottery, gift card, or prize you don't remember entering? Here's how to tell if it's real before you respond.

item.title: How to Check If a WhatsApp Message Is Fake
item.description: A practical, no-jargon checklist for spotting fake WhatsApp forwards and scam messages before you share or act on them.
